name: 1/10 Roof Light Bar
desc: An LED light bar designed to be mounted on the roof of a 1/10 scale RC vehicle. It provides additional illumination for night driving and enhances the scale appearance.

name: 1/10 Maintenance Stand
desc: A rotating stand designed to hold 1/10 scale RC vehicles during repair or maintenance. It provides a stable platform to work on the chassis and suspension components.

name: 1.9 inch Silicone Tyre Inserts
desc: These silicone inserts replace standard foam inside 1.9 inch tires. They provide consistent support and help the tire maintain its shape under load.

name: 1.0 inch Crawler Tyres
desc: These 1.0 inch tires are intended for micro crawler wheels. They are used to replace stock tires for better traction during rock crawling.

name: Injora 1.0 inch Crawler Tyres
desc: These 1.0 inch tires from Injora are designed for small-scale rock crawlers. They provide improved grip on various off-road surfaces.

name: HobbyPark 9kg Waterproof Digital Mini Servo with Stainless Steel Gears
fits: Traxxas TRX-4M, TRX-4MT, 1/18 crawlers, FCX18, FCX24, H18P
desc: This digital mini servo is a high-torque upgrade for small-scale RC crawlers like the TRX-4M. It features stainless steel gears for increased durability and is waterproof for reliable performance in wet conditions. The unit provides 9kg of stall torque to improve steering precision on difficult terrain.
